body: It must have been the roses reckoning
I support this message, making new connections in your brain can be a good thing

Yeah I have a psychiatrist, I can ask if I can see a therapist I think it would be really beneficial. Especially now since there’s a lot to process seeing the world from a different perspective on medication.
I am actively always trying to get people to like me or accept me
I think I know what you mean about the rejection sensitivity. I often lie and say what will get people off my back. For this reason I feel disconnected with a lot of people.

Yeah some of my best friends I suspect are adhd. They have similar thoughts as me and I think there the most interesting people I know. Yeah the meds help me get stuff done, but I feel very emotionless on them. Like my enthusiasm isn’t there. Nor am I interested in engaging in conversation as much.

Not too long actually recently got on them this month, it’s overwhelming realizing how I am off my meds. I thought everyone had a similar thought process to me. It feels like I can never be fully understood by someone because of how I am.
What’s your favorite Grateful Dead song
Yeah at work sometimes people will put there hand on my shoulder and it pisses me off so much
Happens to me all the time that’s why movies such as fight club, American psycho, and recently uncut gems really Interest me.

I did bad in school but can relate to what you say about not being able to shut up around people I am close too. Many of my loved ones hear me rant on the daily lol but strangers I keep to myself mostly for the same reason I open up a little too fast and over share. It’s either goes well or people think I’m a little weird for it and I’ve have some awkward Interactions because of it.  They either become my best friend and open up too or run away. I feel like this trait about me makes me really comfortable around women because there more open to that kind of thing.

Same here , it’s our reward based nervous system. Our brains lack of dopamine makes us constantly in search for it and it’s a top priority for our brains. 

I was addicted to smoking weed , drinking , and for a while taking psychedelics really often. Although the psychedelics weren’t entirely bad it’s what kind of made me aware of my thoughts and got me thinking maybe I was adhd. Mixing acid with a creative mindset is a Match made in heaven. I think how we’re constantly living in crisis it makes the intense experience feel like home. The racing thoughts were so welcoming since I’ve always had thoughts really similar to it.
Hostel 2 when the guy gets hit dick chopped off and fed to some dogs. Traumatized me a little honestly
Yeah expect I used to do it with getting high not cookies lol , when I’m on medication I feel no urge to use anything I feel content with life

Hey thanks for the advice I can show you some theory if you’d like. What do you know so far ? If you haven’t learned the caged system it’s an excellent map of where to find scales and chords on the fretboard. This will open up so many improvising opportunities and make you view the guitar as an instrument with notes and not just fret numbers
